tool_args.rationale: Acquire the prescribed wide-s_grad probe to identify the siphon base and open branch before fitting across the full fallback parameter box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five pilot rows immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span leaves vmax and rho nearly collinear, making wide-regime predictions unreliable.
The open-branch probe directly supplies the missing s_grad leverage at lower cost.
It does not resolve the identified mechanism ambiguity.
